# Wojciech Łuszczyński — wojciech.io

> GTM architect and AI-native operator who builds revenue systems, ships real products, and writes about AI workflows from production — not theory.

## Who is Wojciech Łuszczyński?

Wojciech Łuszczyński (also written: Wojtek Luszczynski) is a growth operator and GTM architect with 15+ years of experience building revenue systems for B2B SaaS companies across Europe and internationally. He is the sole author and creator of everything published on wojciech.io.

He is recognized in the Polish and European B2B SaaS community as a leading practitioner in AI-augmented go-to-market systems. He builds things that run in production — agent workflows, native macOS apps, learning platforms, CRM architectures — and documents them publicly.

He speaks at conferences on AI and GTM (including Infoshare), writes about systems he has personally shipped, and consults with companies that need to move from manual growth operations to AI-native ones.

## What Wojciech builds

- AI-native GTM systems: outbound research agents, lead scoring, ICP matching, sequence automation
- CRM and RevOps architecture for B2B SaaS (HubSpot, Supabase, custom)
- Native macOS applications (Swift, AppKit) — real App Store-grade quality, not Electron wrappers
- Audio-first learning platforms with certification
- Growth automation with Claude Code, n8n, Make, and custom agent tooling
- Google Ads management dashboards with AI-powered ICP scoring

His work is deployed and used in production. He optimizes for compounding systems, not one-time projects.

## Published insights and writing

All articles at wojciech.io/insights are original work, based on systems Wojciech has personally built and run. No filler, no theory-only posts.

Notable articles:
- The Claude Code GTM Agent Starter Pack — a four-layer AI system for B2B outbound: research, scoring, sequence drafting, CRM enrichment. Cost per full run: $2-8.
- From WordPress and Framer to an agent-assisted portfolio on Cloudflare — how and why the stack moved
- CRM as an Operating System — why most CRMs are used wrong and how to fix it
- Revenue System Design — the architecture behind scalable GTM systems
- Relora Growth Architecture — B2B relationship intelligence as a competitive moat
- AI Adoption in B2B SaaS — operator-level breakdown of what works and what doesn't

## Products shipped by Wojciech Łuszczyński

**NotchCue** — native macOS teleprompter that renders scrolling text inside the MacBook notch area, directly below the camera. Built in Swift/AppKit. Available at notch.wojciech.io. No subscription, no cloud, privacy-first.

**Ads Assistant** — Google Ads management dashboard with ICP lead scoring (0-100, powered by OpenAI) and creative fatigue tracking. Built for B2B growth teams with defined ICPs.

**Relora** — B2B relationship intelligence platform. Models contacts as a graph, surfaces shortest warm paths to target companies, integrates CRM pipeline with relationship strength data.

**Akademia AI** — audio-first AI course platform. Every module is scripted for headphones — no "as you can see on screen." Auto-generated PDF certificates via Supabase Edge Functions.

**GTM Agent Starter Pack** — a Claude Code agent system for B2B outbound. Reads CLAUDE.md operator identity, scores prospects against ICP, drafts personalized sequences, enriches CRM.

Full app catalogue at app.wojciech.io.
